text:
chris: heads up — seeing very short fan-speed microbursts on 3 GPUs in rack-7 around midnight, plus brief power/voltage transients. Inference p95 on /v1/generate spiked from ~120ms -> ~540ms. Also saw an Xid 62 once. :eyes:

maya: which nodes? can you paste dmesg / nvidia logs?

chris: nodes: node-rack7-02, node-rack7-03, node-rack7-05. snippet from dmesg + driver: 
```
[ 12.345678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 62, Channel:0
[ 12.345679] nvidia: GPU 0: power drop detected
[ 12.345680] thermal: fan speed jump 1200 -> 4200 rpm (200ms)
[ 12.345681] kernel: GPU 0 clock throttled for 250ms
```

lee: check ECC counters too. if uncorr ECC rises it's a hardware fault. run: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.uncorrected.volatile --format=csv` and `watch -n1 nvidia-smi dmon -s u`

chris: quick nvidia-smi sample: 
```
GPU  Name        Uncorr_ECC
0    A100-40GB   0
1    A100-40GB   2
2    A100-40GB   0
```
(only GPU1 shows 2 uncorr since 23:58)

infra-bot: telemetry: rack-7 ambient=28.1C @00:03, PSU rail showed short ~80ms current spikes at +12% baseline, powercap stayed at 250W. fan RPM telemetry shows 3 microbursts between 23:58-00:04.

maya: mitigation plan: cordon + drain the two most affected nodes and shift traffic. commands: 
`kubectl cordon node-rack7-03`
`kubectl drain node-rack7-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
(repeat for node-rack7-05).

sre-oncall: do we have spare capacity in the same AZ to absorb pods? if not, create temporary fallback routing for /v1/generate to pool-cold. Also want to avoid a simultaneous mass drain during peak.

chris: executed cordon/drain for node-rack7-03 and node-rack7-05. moved a subset of replicas off node-rack7-02 to observe. p95 improved to ~130ms after draining two nodes. continuing watch. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: created INC-4821: https://infra/incidents/4821 assigned to @lee (P2) :clipboard:

lee: ordering replacement cards for node-rack7-03 and -05, will also run extended burn-in after swap. plan for post-swap stress test: `stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 600s` and `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` while monitoring klog.

maya: ops — can we bump rack-7 chiller setpoint -1C (i.e., a bit colder) for the next 6 hours to reduce thermal transients?

sre-oncall: ops approved -1C for 6 hours starting now. we'll watch telemetry dashboards and paging thresholds. :white_check_mark:

chris: logging artifacts to S3: s3://infra-logs/rack7/1849998888/ ; attaching dmesg, nvidia-smi dumps, and perf traces. will update INC-4821 with root-cause timeline.

maya: follow-up items: (1) run ECC/passive-error correlation across last 30 days for rack-7, (2) add a short-lived alert for sub-second fan RPM spikes, (3) validate PSU rail aggregation math in telemetry.

lee: noted. I'll coordinate replacements and set a temporary scheduling tag `do-not-schedule=rack7-hot` until replacements complete.

chris: thanks team. keeping channel updated. :coffee:
